name: everything-exam-preparation
description: A standalone exam-preparation Plugin for Course Atlas, past-paper Analysis, knowledge Notes, Practice, solution books, and exam Essays.

interface.shortDescription: Build standalone exam and revision assets from course files.
interface.longDescription: Creates Course Atlas packages, interpretable past-paper analysis, knowledge-only Notes, Practice and solution books, and exam Essay learning views directly from user-supplied sources.
defaultPrompt: Turn these course files into a source-grounded Course Atlas ZIP.
Analyse these formal past papers and map recurring question families.
Create a verified solution book or annotated exam model essay.
